timing.rule: A feature for signal date D uses only rows with known_from at or before D. Every NSE file row has known_from = next session after its trade_date, so a feature for D reads source_trade_date at most the session before D
timing.columns: every table has signal_date, source_trade_date, known_from
timing.truncation_test: features for D are identical when rebuilt from data with trade_date at or before D-1
timing.difference_from_gate: gate v1 and v2 baselines use the close of their signal date, whose known_from is the next session. Features here are one session staler than those baselines. Alignment for a model is decided in the model prompt

universe.symbol_links: no window crosses any symbol link, flagged or not
universe.lots: no lot-based feature; turnover and open interest in shares are used, contract counts of futures are not

liquidity.rule: from candidates 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 contracts on the thinner leg, the smallest at which the put-call parity flag rate is at most 1%, on european rows of 2015-2022, with no return or target read
liquidity.liquid_pair: both legs traded with close > 0, thinner leg at or above the threshold, neither leg flagged for parity or below-intrinsic
liquidity.threshold_period_only: the threshold is chosen on 2015-2022 and applied to every year

option_inputs.model: Black-76 on the out-of-the-money leg at each strike's own call and put
option_inputs.forward: K + exp(rT)(C - P) at the liquid pair with the smallest |C - P| for that expiry
option_inputs.front_expiry: nearest expiry with at least 7 calendar days and a liquid pair
option_inputs.next_expiry: next expiry with a liquid pair

handling.near_contract: nearest expiry on or after the session; a return uses one contract on two consecutive sessions, so a roll is never a return
handling.discontinuity: a source session is a discontinuity if any of: an NSE action file ex-date of a split, bonus, demerger, consolidation, scheme of arrangement, amalgamation or capital reduction; the split_events price and OI footprint; an OI reset (oi_reset_flag); a near-contract one-day move at or below -40% or at or above +66.7%
handling.on_a_discontinuity: return, gap, range and OI-change features of that session are missing; OI history restarts (epoch), so no OI window spans it. The flags never go in a model as a signal: role handling_flag
handling.known_limit: a discontinuity with no listing, no footprint, no reset and a move inside the limits cannot be detected
handling.no_forward_fill: missing stays missing. No value is carried across sessions
handling.holes_and_holidays: windows are in sessions. A hole (2013-10-09, 2021-03-30) is a session with no data: the return after it is missing
handling.no_trade: a near contract with zero contracts traded has missing return and range features
handling.winsorizing: stored values are never clipped. Limits are the 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles per feature, fitted on signal dates to 2022-12-31, U2 rows; applied by a function at model time. Flags, calendar features and ranks are not clipped. No other scaling
handling.clusters: Pearson on winsorized values, development, U1 stocks, pairwise complete, at least 1,000 rows; average linkage on 1 - |rho|, cut at 0.30. Above 0.95 is flagged, never dropped
handling.selection: no feature is selected, dropped or tuned on target relationships

coverage_stored.board_notices: 29 symbols, from 2017-12; those symbols are today's, so this source has survivorship
coverage_stored.action_files: 2015-02 to 2024-12, months missing as in gate v2
